title: Wood Solo #41 (목재 솔로 · bocote · 체형 BBW bombshell · 배경 갤러리 · 극단 힐)

Dense fitted sections — BLAZING golden bocote grain across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID dark brown swirling lines running between the carved sections, polished to a warm satin sheen, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
